backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Creates a consistent snapshot of the application database (accounts, libraries, metadata, listening progress, bookmarks, saved lists) while the server keeps running. Media files are never modified; thumbnail caches can be regenerated, and cover art can be included with backups below.
backup.pathTitle: Where the server writes backups. In Docker this is a path inside the container — it sits under the folder you mapped to /config.
backup.uploadBackupTitle: Upload a backup file from your computer
backup.restoredNotice: Restore staged from {{name}}. Restart the server to apply it.
backup.restoredNoticeDbOnly: Restore staged from {{name}}, database only — cover art left as it is. Restart the server to apply it.
backup.uploaded: Uploaded {{name}}. It's ready to restore from the list below.
backup.runAutomatically: Run a backup automatically every day
backup.noThumbnailStore: No thumbnail store yet — set one under
backup.retentionNote: Applies to manual and scheduled backups. Covers can't all be regenerated (uploaded and provider-fetched art), so including them is recommended. Older backups beyond the limit are removed automatically.
backup.emptyBody: Click "Create backup now" to make one.
backup.restoreBody: The database in {{name}} is staged and replaces the current one the next time the server starts (the current database is saved as an automatic backup first).
backup.restoreCoversNote: Cover art is put back straight away.
backup.alsoRestoreCoversHint: Off is quicker and leaves the covers you have now alone — the database comes back either way.
backup.restoreRestartWarning: You must restart the server to finish — changes made since this backup will be lost.
backup.uploadModalBody: Add a backup from your computer — a full .zip (database + covers) or a database-only .sqlite. It joins the list below, ready to restore.

categories.description: Shelves books land on automatically, based on their tags.
categories.rematchTitle: Recompute every book's category from its tags using the current mappings
categories.helpTagsSourceBody: When books are scanned, their genre values are saved as tags, such as detective, sci-fi, memoir, or history.
categories.helpMappingsBody: Each category has keywords. If a book tag contains one of those keywords, the book can be placed in that category.
categories.helpPriorityBody: If multiple keywords match the same book, the keyword with the higher priority wins.
categories.helpFallbackTitle: No match goes to General / Other
categories.helpFallbackBody: Books without a matching keyword stay in General / Other until a better keyword is added.
categories.helpExampleBody: A book has the tag historical mystery. If Mystery & Thriller has keyword mystery with priority 20, and History has keyword history with priority 10, the book goes to Mystery & Thriller because mystery matches and has the higher priority.
categories.helpNote: Open a category and use <bold>Mappings</bold> to add keywords manually, or <bold>Tags</bold> to turn a scanned tag into a keyword. After changing mappings, run <bold>Re-match all</bold> to update existing books.
categories.unableToAddTagAsKeyword: Unable to add tag as keyword
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteMoveConfirm_one: Delete this category and move {{count}} book to General / Other?
categories.deleteMoveConfirm_other: Delete this category and move {{count}} books to General / Other?
categories.noTagsYet: No tags yet. Scan a library and tags appear from book genres.

groups.deleteBody1: This will remove the group and its membership records.
groups.deleteBody2: User accounts, libraries, and files are not deleted.

invites.description: Create and retire sign-up links for new accounts.
invites.emptyFiltered: No invite links match this search.

invites.deleteBody1: This invite link will no longer be usable.
invites.deleteBody2: Existing user accounts and accepted invites are not changed.

libraries.description: Every library on this server, what it scans, and who can see it.
libraries.storageSetupBody: Configure thumbnail storage and at least one Digital Library container before adding libraries.
libraries.scanInProgress_one: "{{name}}" is being scanned — file counts update automatically as it runs.
libraries.scanInProgress_other: {{count}} libraries are being scanned — file counts update automatically as they run.
libraries.takeOwnershipTitle: This private library is owned by someone else. Take ownership to manage it (logged).
libraries.rescanIntro: Re-index this library from disk. Your files are never modified, and manually edited metadata is kept.
libraries.rescanScopeNote: These choices apply to this scan only — edit the library to change its defaults.
libraries.deleteBody1: This will remove the library and all its book records, metadata, series, and genres from the database.
libraries.deleteBody2: Your files on disk will not be touched. You can re-add this library at any time and it will be re-scanned from the same folder.
libraries.takeOwnershipBody1: This will give you manager access so you can manage this private library. The action is logged for audit history.
libraries.takeOwnershipBody2: The library contents and existing owner are not deleted. Files on disk are not changed.
libraries.companionsLabel: Companion files (upload only — covers, metadata, documents)
libraries.companionsEmptyHint: No companion files — uploads accept the formats above only.
libraries.progressLinear: Audiobook — one resume point for the whole book
libraries.progressEpisodic: Episodic — track each track separately (radio shows, podcasts)
libraries.progressEpisodicHint: Episodic gives each track its own played/unplayed state, so skipping one never marks the others done.
libraries.chooseFolderIntro: Choose a folder inside an approved container.
libraries.noContainersYet: No Digital Library containers yet — add one above, and its folders can be browsed here.
libraries.noChildFolders: No child folders found. The current folder can still be used.
libraries.extensionsEmptyHint: No extensions — nothing will be scanned.
libraries.resetDefaultsTitle: Restore the default extensions for this library type
libraries.scanSourcesHint: Select items to scan. Drag the handle or use the arrows to change the order in which they are processed.
libraries.tagEncodingHint: Repairs garbled tag text (e.g. "Ðàíåå" → "Ранее") for files whose tags were saved in this legacy encoding. Correctly stored tags are left untouched.
libraries.uploadStandardHint: Up to 10 GB per file — big enough for any single upload, small enough that a runaway upload can't fill the disk.
libraries.uploadCustomHint: Set a maximum size for each file.
libraries.externalReadOnlyHint: External libraries are read-only — uploads are disabled.
libraries.modeManagedFull: Managed — this app owns the files
libraries.modeExternalFull: External — read-only, managed outside this app
libraries.visibilityRowDescription: Control who can see this library.
libraries.publicAccessRowDescription: Choose what public users can do.
